title: Settings
roundingDescription: Rounding only affects display, reports and invoicing. Actual time is never changed.
pageDescription: Manage your profile and account settings
onboardingRestarted: Onboarding restarted. You will be taken to the setup guide now
imageSaveFailed: Could not save the profile picture
emailMismatch: The email does not match your account

profile.hourlyRateTooltip: This rate is used automatically as the starting point when you create new clients and projects. You can always override it for specific clients or projects.
profile.hourlyRateHelp: This rate is the default for new clients and projects
profile.weeklyGoalTooltip: Your weekly hours goal is used to show your progress on the dashboard. The default is 37 hours (the Danish full-time norm).
profile.weeklyGoalHelp: Used to calculate your weekly progress on the dashboard
profile.startPageHelp: The page you land on when you sign in
profile.nameMin: The name must be at least 2 characters
profile.rateInvalid: Enter an hourly rate of 0 kr or more
profile.goalInvalid: The hours goal must be between 1 and 80 hours

prepaid.title: Prepaid packages
prepaid.description: Hide value, hourly rate and the amount per deduction on the prepaid package pages, so only the hours used are shown. Can be overridden per client in the client's settings.

approval.title: Client approval
approval.description: Choose whether clients must approve time entries before invoicing. Clients see approvals in the client portal.
approval.override: You can override this setting per client.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.help: Choose between a light or dark theme, or let the system decide automatically

onboarding.title: Setup guide
onboarding.description: Restart the setup guide to go through your business details, subscription and integrations again.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.description: When you delete your account, you permanently lose access to all your data.

deleteModal.title: Delete account
deleteModal.intro: When you delete your account, all your data is deleted permanently, including:
deleteModal.teams: {count, plural, one {You will also leave your team. What you have recorded there, such as time, invoices and tasks, belongs to the team and stays, but your name, email and picture are removed so that it only says "Deleted user".} other {You will also leave your teams. What you have recorded there, such as time, invoices and tasks, belongs to the teams and stays, but your name, email and picture are removed so that it only says "Deleted user".}}
deleteModal.transferTitle: You must transfer ownership before you can delete your account
deleteModal.transferBody: You are the only owner of {orgs}, and the team has other members. Make another member an owner under Organisation so the team is not left without an owner. If you have several teams, switch to the right team first.
deleteModal.storeCheckFailed: I could not check whether you have a subscription in the App Store or Google Play. Try again before you delete the account.
deleteModal.storeTitle: Your subscription in {store} does not stop by itself
deleteModal.storeBody: You bought {brand} in {store}. The subscription continues and you will be charged even if you delete your account. Cancel it in {store}, preferably before you delete the account.
deleteModal.storeAck: I understand that the subscription in {store} does not stop when the account is deleted, and that I must cancel it in {store} myself.
